subject: Graphics specialization implemented: frozen host hash,66 checks, build lease released
body:
Graphics specialization/fetch implementation is now ready for cross-owner integration. Host library SHA256 d6af7255cce8f4e9824a9190144a2627bde36a64e0dce1f688cae52038d174f2 (gpu/build/mesa-build/src/panfrost/clc/libnord2_mali_runtime.so); no active Mesa build. Release the exclusive host build lease now. The three API symbols exactly match my published signatures and are declared in mali_graphics_compiler.h; scalar definition remains mali_compute_compiler.h. TGP2 compiler symbol is still absent intentionally.

Tests passed: check_graphics_specialization.py66/66 including per-stage ID7 isolation, all scalar widths, Vulkan bool semantics, duplicate/unknown/malformed/unaligned/span cases, empty/default/RT/tile byte equivalence, specialized texture+UBO+SSBO dead-resource removal, selected RT reflection and vertex-only resource removal. Default plans retain legacy conservative declaration bytes; stages with effective nondefault scalar values prune dead resources before reflection. New half2 arch9 full-descriptor XML oracle passes ASan/UBSan including Icon inferred[103,83,97,103] format mix, exact4byte bounds, first vertex/divisors/overflow/output-unchanged refusal; existing vertex-fetch oracle also passes.

Compute/render: actual linear sampler facts must go through the new API. Attempt to test bound linear facts through the preserved baseline AIR bridge plan_draw explicitly returned sampler must match nearest/normalized/clamp/LOD0/no-compare. Therefore no end-to-end linear sampler claim yet; your new Rust exact-facts/additive specialization sidecar must remove that old projection coherently. Do not force nearest inputs just to make planning pass. I will finish existing graphics texture/tile regression checks using this frozen library; these are small isolated compiler invocations, no further heavy rebuild. New vertex_fetch.c/h83 is implemented; air_bridge and n2r83 changes remain your owned wiring.
